# filters

Saved filters.

- Toolset name: `filters`
- Enabled by default: yes
- Tools: 6 (2 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_clone_filter`

**Clone filter** · mutating

Clone a saved filter. Returns the UUID of the copy.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_create_filter`

**Create filter** · mutating

Create a saved filter. Not idempotent.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string | no | Optional comment |
| `name` | string | yes | Filter name |
| `term` | string | no | GMP filter term, e.g. `severity>7 and host=10.0.0.5` |
| `type` | string | no | Resource type the filter applies to, e.g. "result", "task", "report" |

### `openvas_delete_filter`

**Delete filter** · destructive

Delete a saved filter (to the trashcan by default; `ultimate` deletes permanently). Fails with 409 if an alert still uses it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |
| `ultimate` | boolean | no | Permanently delete instead of moving to the trashcan (default false) |

### `openvas_get_filter`

**Get filter** · read-only

Get one saved filter by UUID.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_list_filters`

**List filters** · read-only

List saved filters (reusable GMP filter expressions).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |

### `openvas_update_filter`

**Update filter** · destructive

Update a saved filter's term, type or comment. Idempotent (PUT).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string | no |  |
| `id` | string | yes | UUID of the filter to update |
| `term` | string | no | Replacement GMP filter term |
| `type` | string | no | Replacement resource type |
